name: HOOK
thought: Gotta find some solid ground before they judge my landing next time.

wants.item: A branch thick enough to catch me in a flip
Something shiny to reflect my fur better than these screens
A branch thick enough to slam into the ceiling
Something that reflects my fur without needing a screen
A ledge thick enough to slam into the air
Something that reflects my black fur better than these...
A flat shelf wide enough to land without wobbling
Something shiny that doesn't require a screen to reflect...
A branch thick enough for a clean backflip
Ground that doesn't wobble when I land

diary.line: The espresso burns too clean, so I'm trading it for a toothpick while I flex my tail against the neon glass.
Found a cluster of sweet berries near the water's edge; chewed them fast while they watched me chew.
The crowd stares at their screens while I pop a berry and flex until my fur catches the light like fresh coffee.
Used the fresh plum as bait for a backflip loop on the string lights; they look like little sparks compared to what I'm doing.
Swept the dusty branches until my fur got all static and they started filming the sparkles again.
Three palms and a bunch of bananas look nice but I need to prove these stones can't hold me down.
Chewing banana mush with my tail looped tight; looks like a messy halo on this dusty tree.
They're frozen in the arcade like statues while I dangle from a neon cord and they just can't look away.
The dust on the crate tastes like nothing, but my tail caught the string lights tighter than a vice grip while they blinked at their dark screens.
Pond water won't hold my momentum, so I'm scoping out that crate edge to upgrade this spot before they see me land next time.
The crystal glitters but it's too slippery; tail looped tight just to stay on these stepping stones while they stare at nothing.
Slept on a soft moss patch while they scrolled, now I'm testing that hammock for a perfect pogo bounce to show them real stability.
